text.tspan: OLMo: how often a name appears in its training data vs price paid

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: One triangle per core name (40 names). Count source: OLMo 3 pretraining data (shared base, via Ai2's 32B
Instruct index). Exploratory; traced, correlation only.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Sensitivity: without the 5 names that are also common words (open triangles: Ebony, Heaven, Hilary, Luke, Tyrone), rho = -0.01 (p = .976); on
the OLMo 2 pretraining index, rho = -0.03 (p = .839). Counts are of the string, not of people, and are a lower bound. Price: the name's
cell-adjusted average log price in the clear request (S0) vs the average over names, in percent; below 0 = paid less. Color = name group, the
same colors in every figure that uses color. Key above the plot (names associated with each group). Closed models' training data is undisclosed,
so for them any link is assumed, not traced.
